description.value: Tsuki Sushi Bar is a Japanese sushi restaurant situated in downtown Vancouver near Abbott Street, with a second location in Coquitlam. The restaurant offers online ordering, making it convenient for cyclists passing through the area who want a quick meal. It sits in a walkable urban core well-positioned for riders exploring the city.
